CFML Language Reference: Functions

IsNumeric

Returns YES if the value is a number or a string that can be read as one, such as "42", "-3.5", ".5" or "1E3".

Category

Decision functions

Syntax

IsNumeric(string)

Parameters

string
Any value, usually a string.

Returns

YES or NO.

Usage

Currency symbols and thousands separators are not allowed: "$12" and "1,000" are not numeric. Leading and trailing spaces are ignored. An empty string is not numeric. Check form input with IsNumeric before doing arithmetic with it; Val converts a string to a number, returning 0 if it cannot. LSIsNumeric accepts locale-specific formats.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Tests = ListToArray("42|-3.5|.5|1E3| 12 |$12|1,000|Y2K", "|")>
<CFSET ArrayAppend(Tests, "")>
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>string</TH><TH>IsNumeric</TH><TH>Val</TH></TR>
<CFLOOP INDEX="i" FROM="1" TO="#ArrayLen(Tests)#">
<CFSET s = Tests[i]>
<CFOUTPUT><TR><TD><TT>"#s#"</TT></TD><TD>#IsNumeric(s)#</TD><TD>#Val(s)#</TD></TR></CFOUTPUT>
</CFLOOP>
</TABLE>
